0022600114.text: The Orlando Magic (0-2, 14th in the East and 2 games back in the Southeast) visit the New York Knicks (0-2, 12th in the East and 2 games back in the Atlantic) in the third game of the season for Orlando, with both teams still searching for their first win. Orlando is missing Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee), and Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Anthony Black is listed as day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision. New York has Jose Alvarado listed as day-to-day with an ankle sprain, also a game-time decision, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27 after splitting their 2025-26 series 2-2, with the most recent meeting on December 13, 2025 in Orlando, where the Magic lost 132-120.
